text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To relieve Mihono Bourbon's fatigue, we 
came to the Yukoma Onsen. ...However.

text_block_list.name: Grumpy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I told you, I don't need that fake smile 
of yours!!"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Please don't say that, dear customer. 
After nicely warming up, staying out here 
too long will give you a chill.

text_block_list.name: Grumpy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Leave me alone! It doesn't matter where I 
am, does it?! Go away!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Pardon me. I shall come call 
for you later once lunch is prepared.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...Tough opponent. I still have a long way 
to go.

text_block_list.name: Lively Customer
text_block_list.text:
...You'd want to end on a good memory, 
right? At least for the last moment before 
quitting the club...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(The emotions you see on the surface 
aren't always what's truly in their heart. 
...The deeper feelings hidden beneath 
what's visible.)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Are you truly angry, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Grumpy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Aaah!? The hell's your problem, you 
punk...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Because I don't understand.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Why are you angry? What lies beneath that 
anger?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Is it possible for someone to get angry 
without a reason? Let alone toward the 
landlady who treats us so kindly... My 
circuits cannot connect the dots.

text_block_list.name: Grumpy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Tch, a lecture? Really?! Don't follow me!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Anger typically manifests as 
dissatisfaction with something. If so, I 
deduce the essence of this emotion stems 
from 'that dissatisfaction.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
“What is the cause of your 
dissatisfaction? Is it with the service? 
Did something unpleasant happen 
beforehand?”

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry. If you do not tell 
me, I cannot understand.

text_block_list.name: Grumpy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: How far are you gonna follow me?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to know. What lies deep 
beneath your anger.

text_block_list.name: Grumpy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*, so persistent. What a weirdo.

text_block_list.name: Grumpy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, haha. Talk about no hesitation... 
You really just ask that straight to my 
face, huh.

text_block_list.name: Grumpy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Messed up my leg a bit. I'm resting it 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Grumpy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I got hurt, everyone's been 
treating me like I'm fragile. Giving me 
empty platitudes and surface-level 
comfort...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You became unable to speak from the heart. 
What arose was "distance from those around 
you"—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I understand now. Your anger was just 
the other side of your "loneliness," 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Have you looked outside?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I thought you wanted to be treated 
normally, even with your injury.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Let's go look around together. I have 
already installed the surrounding map and 
data.

text_block_list.name: Previously Grumpy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "...Hah. What's your deal?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A guide. And— someone you can talk to 
freely, without holding back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon Mihono Bourbon's return, I listened 
to what happened with the displeased 
Umamusume—
choice_data_list:
It seems you really saw deep into their 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(...Does Master also possess them? 
Feelings, deep within his heart...?)
